experiments.hypothesis: The /oferta-b landing page turns paid visitors into form submits better than the home page '/'. Paid session-to-submit is 2.5% today (48 of 1,935 all time); we want to detect a doubling to 5%. Start only after the mobile form fix, so the test isn't swamped by form errors.
experiments.variant: Duplicate the paid ad(s) into two copies with the same creative and budget. Version A links to '/', version B links to '/oferta-b'.
experiments.metric: Form submits per paid session, per version (web_sessions by landing and ad_id).

questions_for_owner: Who increased the budget this week (total 126.66 → 208.77 EUR, mostly ad 9002)? Was it a manual change or did Meta's campaign budget shift it to the cheapest-click ad? Is the campaign optimizing for link clicks rather than leads?
Have you tried submitting the contact form on a phone? Which field or message causes the error?
Who handles first contact with new leads, and can they commit to replying within 2 hours on working days?
What are /oferta and /oferta-b, and where is their direct traffic coming from (QR code, a link you shared)? Should we point paid ads at them?
Leads from ads have qualified less often than organic web leads (13 of 48 vs 38 of 66 all time). Is the ad audience reaching the right sectors?
